scope: Retained measured phases; conditional bounds only, no new cold performance measurement
conclusion: Even eliminating first-pass preparation, serialization, identity and final verification leaves the retained independent replay work above the207.36second planning target at the measured worker rates. Reusing replay decode would violate the historical endpoint. A substantial independently verified decoder-throughput improvement or wider critical-path change is needed; no cosmetic runtime change or equivalent full cold campaign admitted.
retained_runtime: Round8 exact-byte verifier speedup and round7 full-corpus bounded video reuse remain implemented and qualified in their measured scopes.
nested_timer_policy: Worker sums overlap across four processes; divide by workers only as ideal same-work lower bound. Do not add nested video preprocessing/decode timers.

new_measured_setup_opportunity.decision: One opt-in bounded parallel JSONL media hash implementation and three counterbalanced CPU pairs; full hashing, identities and error handling retained. Does not remove independent uncached replay or close historical cold requirement.
